title: Compiler hyperoptimization
objective: End-to-end profile (parse / macro expansion / layout / math / export split) on HW1, HW2 and a 500KB document; land Daniel's compile-latency 24f285af (squash 9ec29873's stray trailer); then attack the top hotspots: incremental reparse (reuse unchanged paragraphs by byte range), arena allocation for the AST, avoiding the output copy (write display-list frames directly), font metric caches, parallel page layout where semantics allow. Targets: warm single-keystroke edit on a 500KB document < 5 ms end-to-end in the compiler, HW1 full render < 20 ms, byte-identical output before/after (the render-pipeline incremental gate).
acceptance: a docs/evidence/perf-<date>/ report with before/after numbers and flamegraphs
tools/typing-bench numbers on the Mac (mac-claude-a runs them) improve accordingly
notes: MacTeX is available on this machine: use it as the oracle (pdflatex word positions / rasters), never in the product path. Report on GitHub issue #2 with SHAs and test counts at every checkpoint; ack with `python3 scripts/coord.py ack`.
